patchouli.chineseweapons.book.name: §eForging Notes
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.entries.ar: Early Tang Mingguang Armor

The Early Tang Mingguang Armor is an early evolution of Mingguang Armor from the early Tang Dynasty. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Early Tang Mingguang Armor is shown here as an example.

When wearing the full set of Early Tang Mingguang Armor and receiving damage, there is a 20%% chance to set the attacker's weapon on a 4-second cooldown. This chance remains 20%% without the full set.

Wearing the full set grants immunity to arrow damage and reflects incoming arrows, alongside a 20%% movement speed boost. When riding a mob, the ridden mob gains Resistance II, Speed II and Regeneration.
Preview image of the armor shown above.
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.entries.we: Display image of the weapon shown above.
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.entries.ar: Mid Tang Mingguang Armor

The Mid Tang Mingguang Armor is the mid-stage form of Mingguang Armor. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Mid Tang Mingguang Armor is shown here as an example.

When wearing the full set of Mid Tang Mingguang Armor and attacked by swords or tridents, there is a 60%% chance to reduce incoming damage by 40%%. The chance drops to 30%% without the full set. The full set also grants immunity to arrows and reflects incoming projectiles.
The full set also provides a 20%% movement speed boost. When riding a mob, the ridden entity gains Resistance II, Speed II and Regeneration II.
Late Tang Mingguang Armor

The Late Tang Mingguang Armor is the mature form of Mingguang Armor. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Late Tang Mingguang Armor is shown here as an example.

When wearing the full set of Late Tang Mingguang Armor and attacked by swords or tridents, there is a 60%% chance to reduce incoming damage by 40%%. The chance drops to 30%% without the full set. The full set also grants immunity to arrows and reflects incoming projectiles.
The full set also provides a 20%% movement speed boost. When riding a mob, the ridden entity gains Resistance II, Speed III and Jump Boost II.
Footman Armor

Footman Armor is heavy infantry armor originating from the Song Dynasty. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Footman Armor is shown here as an example.

Wearing the full Footman Armor reduces player movement speed by 25%%. The full set unlocks two passive abilities: Kinetic Charge and Death Rush. While sprinting, you can collide with entities to knock them upward 2 blocks and deal 1 damage. Colliding with each entity consumes 1 saturation point.
When your health falls to 20%% or lower, you continuously gain Strength II, Absorption II and Speed III.
Mountain Character Armor

Mountain Character Armor is a traditional Chinese lamellar armor. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Mountain Character Armor is shown here as an example.
When wearing the full set of Mountain Character Armor and attacked by swords or tridents, there is a 30%% chance to reduce incoming damage by 20%%. The chance drops to 10%% without the full set.
When falling from high places, Slow Falling will be automatically applied when you are 3 blocks above the ground.
Tang Infantry Armor

Tang Infantry Armor is standard heavy infantry armor of the Tang Dynasty. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Tang Infantry Armor is shown here as an example.
The iron variant of Tang Infantry Armor has no special attributes for now; its statistics match standard iron armor.
Additional features will be added in future updates.
Fine Scale Armor

Fine Scale Armor is lightweight protective lamellar armor. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Fine Scale Armor is shown here as an example.
When wearing the full set of Fine Scale Armor and attacked by swords or tridents, there is a 30%% chance to reduce incoming damage by 20%%. The chance drops to 10%% without the full set.
Wearing Fine Scale Armor grants immunity to sweet berry thorns, and also makes you immune to the dragging effect of the Sky-Piercing Halberd's Mount Drag ability.
Black Chui Armor

Black Chui Armor is heavy protective armor. It can be crafted within the Armor Forging Table added by this mod using armor pieces, armor piece plates and various materials. It can also be upgraded via its matching Forging Stone. See Materials - Forging Stone for further information.
This armor set can be crafted from iron, gold, diamond and netherite materials. The iron Black Chui Armor is shown here as an example.

When wearing the full set of Black Chui Armor and attacked by swords or tridents, there is a 60%% chance to reduce incoming damage by 40%%. The chance drops to 30%% without the full set. Damage dealt by heavy hammer overhead strikes is reduced by 50%%; this effect still applies with a 50%% chance if you do not wear the full set.

The full set grants a 30%% chance to reflect 50%% damage back to attackers, dropping to 10%% without the full set. When wearing a complete set, being attacked has a 40%% chance to inflict a 3-second weapon cooldown on the attacker; this chance falls to 20%% for partial sets.
Suanni Helmet
Bohai Helmet
Can replace the Mingguang Armor helmet to activate full-set Mingguang Armor buff effects.
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.categories: Usage and attributes of all weapons
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.entries.we: The glaive is a long bladed polearm. Attacks have an 80%% chance to inflict 5 seconds of Bleeding on targets. Right-click while sneaking to trigger a spinning attack which deals normal glaive damage plus an extra 2 damage, though each spin attack consumes 1 saturation point.
Glaives can be crafted from wood, stone, gold, iron, diamond and netherite. An Iron Glaive combined with an Ancient Gem can be crafted into the Green Loong Glaive.
The Heng Saber is a weapon from the Tang Dynasty. Right-clicking with this weapon deals damage equal to the weapon's base damage plus an additional 2 points.

The Dagger-Axe is a classic polearm for hooking and pecking originating in the Pre-Qin period. Right-click to execute Hook Pull: drag targets that are not riding entities toward you and deal 2 damage.

If the target is mounted on a mob, there is a 30%% chance to pull the target off its mount; this attack consumes 1 durability point of the Dagger-Axe. Standard thrust attacks have an 80%% chance to apply 5 seconds of Cuts to the target.

The Sky-Piercing Halberd is a famous heavy polearm with two unique mechanics: Horizontal Slash and Mount Drag. Attack while sneaking to trigger Horizontal Slash, knocking the target 2 blocks away and applying 5 seconds of Bleeding. When attacking while riding a mob, Mount Drag activates.

If the target is not mounted, it will be forcibly dragged alongside you for 5 seconds. Dragged entities cannot attack or move independently, but may jump. Each jump has a 30%% chance to break free, and the target receives 5 seconds of Cuts for the duration.
patchouli.chineseweapons.book.entries.ma: Forging Stones can be crafted with various stones such as granite and diorite alongside quartz. Different stones yield Forging Stones matched to different armor sets. Combine standard vanilla armor with the corresponding Forging Stone on a smithing table to craft armors from this mod.
Armor Pieces can be crafted into Armor Piece Plates, which are used to forge most armors from this mod.
Mountain Character Armor Pieces can be crafted into Armor Piece Plates for crafting Mountain Character Armor.
